recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Checked 12 Oct 2026. The stored official_source_url (studyinnl.org/finances/ots-scholarships) is a dead link (HTTP 404) with no archived snapshot in the Wayback Machine. No live official page for the Netherlands Fellowship Programme exists on nuffic.nl or studyinnl.org; Nuffic lists 'NICHE/NFP' only under 'Programmes previously managed by Nuffic:'. The closest official statements of the programme's status are https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/scholarships ('In 2024, the Orange Knowledge Programme ended. That means that there are no new application rounds for this programme.') and https://www.nuffic.nl/en/international/impact-and-results-of-the-orange-knowledge-programme (OKP described in the past tense, 2017-2024). The NFP itself stopped running when its successor OKP was implemented (2018-2024). Do not move this record to active without a new official page appearing; a future re-check should start from the Nuffic programmes page and the Study in NL scholarships overview.

notes_for_reviewer: The programme no longer exists as an applicable scholarship: the record's own source URL is dead, Nuffic lists the NFP as previously managed, and the successor Orange Knowledge Programme ended in 2024 with no new rounds. The title '(NFP/OTS)' also conflates two different programmes - the Orange Tulip Scholarship (OTS) is separately listed by Nuffic as previously managed and is now run decentralised by individual Dutch universities, so it is not the same award. Nuffic's own scholarships overview names the current Nuffic-administered alternatives: MENA Scholarship Programme, NL scholarship (Holland Scholarship) and Erasmus+.
